reason: 该插件的核心用户价值是将 QQ 作为 DeepSeek Harness 的接入端：将 QQ 私聊、群聊或频道消息映射为持久化会话并返回 Agent 响应。证据显示它支持 OneBot11 与 QQ 官方两种通道、会话级上下文、以及通过 qq_send 进行主动消息发送，但也将聊天入口与文件/终端等能力绑定，属于高风险外部服务整合。

summaries.zh: 这是一个将 QQ 聊天接入 DeepSeek Harness 的插件，支持 OneBot11 和 QQ 官方通道，实现按会话持续的 AI 交互与消息回复。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that connects QQ chats via OneBot11 or QQ Official channels for session-based AI interaction and responses.

capabilities: Connects QQ messages to DSH agents via OneBot11 and QQ Official channels
Persists per-session agent context across restarts
Registers a QQ-specific proactive send tool (qq_send) for agent replies
Provides access to filesystem-oriented and terminal-oriented tool actions in QQ sessions
Makes network calls to QQ/OneBot services and external APIs

reasons.code: README states the plugin is a DeepSeek Harness QQ bot integration supporting OneBot 11 (WebSocket) and QQ Official AppID/AppSecret channels, including status/help/reset commands and reconnect behavior.
README describes a full toolchain exposure per QQ session including file read/write, Shell/PowerShell, and web search capabilities, with per-session workspaces.
Package metadata identifies the plugin as a DSH plugin (bundle entry lib/index.js) and targets qq/qqbot/onebot integration, confirming external service coupling.
